dedupe_keys.name: hong kong annotated airborne lidar point clouds

description: Qiaosi Li publishes labelled airborne LiDAR point clouds for 7.2 square kilometres of Shatin, Hong Kong. The August 2024 Zenodo release supplies original and processed point-cloud archives, training and validation splits, and a label file under CC BY 4.0, free to download. Sixteen tiles represent high-rise housing, village houses, public buildings, woodland and planted trees. Eleven tiles support training and five support validation for a weakly supervised semantic-segmentation method. Labels distinguish ground, buildings and trees. These observations can support reconstruction and testing of urban geometry inputs for infrastructure and green-space simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the labelled collection. The underlying LiDAR belongs to the Hong Kong government, whose spatial portal is identified by the depositor; upstream conditions should be retained. Acquisition dates, coordinate reference system, point density, annotation accuracy and processing differences between archives remain unknown. The provider’s single-study label does not negate reuse, but the files were not downloaded.
